title: docs(pm): derive the recommendation from axis 1 first, and five director-lane charter items
body:
Fixes #17748

## What and why

The ≥50% long-term-rationality rule already exists in `SKILL.md`; what was missing was a
mechanical step in the writing template that makes a violation visible on the card. This PR
adds that step and the five director-lane charter items ruled on the same card, in one PR
across three governed reference files. `SKILL.md` and `core-rules.md` are deliberately
untouched — `SKILL.md:756-758` stays the single source of the rule, and no pointer clause is
added here. Six items: (1) the recommendation is derived from axis ① alone and carries a
self-check row; (2) the class-one gate runs on every inbox card before it is presented;
(3) 「以协议为准」 in both halves — consumers align to the protocol, and whether the protocol
itself is right is the seat's own axis-① reading of the protocol text; (4) an ADR item
superseded by the protocol gets a dated amendment note; (5) changeset files are named after
their card; (6) a ruling exists only on its own card, under a fixed header line.

## Line budget — every file stays at its ratchet ceiling, paid by density

All three files sit at headroom 0, so every added line is paid for by a deleted clause whose
rule survives elsewhere. ⛔ No re-wrap was used as currency and ⛔ no ceiling was raised.

| file | lines | ceiling | paid by deleting | where the rule survives |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `references/decision-analysis.md` | 50 → 50 | 50 | :15 「裁后四件原子执行不再请示,一口气跑完;批间新入箱的卡滚入下一批。」 | `lanes/director.md` :43 + :44 (verbatim halves) |
| | | | :16 「收件箱读数为零才收工。」 | `lanes/director.md` :44 「收件箱清零才收工」 |
| | | | :17's enumeration 「业务问题 + 每选项真实代价 + 四维 + 一个推荐」, merged into :18 | the 正文六项 list itself, :24–:33 of the new file |
| `references/lanes/director.md` | 72 → 72 | 72 | :23 「四维框架单源在 SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉,⛔ 本文不复制框架本体。」 | folded into the file header :3, which already carried the same pointer |
| | | | :25 「staged 选项仅凭具名外部用户证据才可荐。」 | `SKILL.md` :749 「staged 选项仅凭具名外部用户证据才可呈报为推荐」 |
| | | | :17's 「机械接手经派发 dev」, merged into :16 | :31 「机械红可接手,经派发 dev 执行」 |
| | | | :71 「契约复核的放行归派发席席内,定时轮与本席降为可选事后审计…」 | :28 「放行常设归派发席席内复核,归属与全链见 `../contract-review.md`」 + the 职责一 heading's 「(可选)」 |
| | | | :48 「入箱先退回:…按一类自裁录裁转 `pm:queue` 修文档,⛔ 不呈批。」 | replaced by item 2's general rule, of which it was the single named instance |
| | | | :46's 「改 ⇒ 重立协议卡,否则只议对齐」 | superseded by item 3 (the seat rules the protocol change; a spec card carries the ruling) |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 241 → 241 | 241 | :215 「豁免不再申报为偏差:一是 harness 的 `Co-Authored-By` 尾注…」 | `AGENTS.md` :444, verbatim in English |

Two further in-place rewrites cost no lines: `decision-analysis.md` :32 (the 推荐 item) expands
from one line to four by absorbing its own gloss, and `dispatch-runbook.md` :84 (出决策箱须引可
取回的裁决 id) gains the `Ruling-ref` half while dropping the 台账条目 alternative that item 6
explicitly rules out.

## Acceptance, measured both directions on `345b15e7` against `origin/main` `00c332b4`

`grep -c` per file, before → after:

| pattern | file | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `只看①选` | `decision-analysis.md` | 0 | **2** (the 推荐 self-check row and the 四棱 recommendation row) |
| `Ruling: batch` | `lanes/director.md` | 0 | **1** (the fixed ruling-header line) |
| `以协议为准` | `lanes/director.md` | 0 | **1** |
| `ADR 条目被协议取代` | `lanes/director.md` | 0 | **1** (the dated-amendment rule) |
| `Ruling-ref` | `dispatch-runbook.md` | 0 | **1** (the claim half) |
| `changeset 文件名用` | `dispatch-runbook.md` | 0 | **1** (item 5, beside the 模型标识 block) |

Literal controls, unchanged: `Prior rulings read` 1 → 1 in `decision-analysis.md`;
「裁前先读线程」 1 → 1 in `lanes/director.md` (kept verbatim on its own line when :9 was split).
`git diff --stat origin/main` shows exactly three files, 18 insertions / 18 deletions.
No line exceeds 120 bytes in any of the three files (measured, 0 offenders), and a control-character
sweep over the three files returns no hits.

Placeholder note: the ruling header and the changeset-name rule are written in the files with
angle-bracket placeholders. Spelled here without them so this body survives GitHub's sanitizer,
the header is `Ruling: batch #N item K · letter X · maintainer 「VERBATIM」 UTC` and the changeset
rule names `ISSUE-SLUG.md`.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
(no paths — the tool took the change set from the merge base itself): 14 families, all 14 run,
all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` → `14 derived, 14 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
`check:pm-governed-prose` was run in addition (named in the dispatch, outside the derivation).
`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited **3 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET** (nothing measured);
after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under
`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` it re-ran and exited 0.

`check:pm-skill-ratchet` verdict lines:

```
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .../references/decision-analysis.md is 50 lines (ceiling 50; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .../references/lanes/director.md is 72 lines (ceiling 72; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .../references/dispatch-runbook.md is 241 lines (ceiling 241; headroom 0).
```

No changeset: `.claude/**` publishes nothing — none of the three paths appears in any package's
`files[]` — so the `skip-changeset` label carries it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 三个 PM 章程文件,一共六条规则。一、决策卡的推荐从此先只按「项目长远合理性」
这一轴得出,写一句两年后的终态并点名参照哪个主流平台,其余三轴只调时序与分期、不许改字母;推荐段
和四棱卡面各带一行自检「只看①选 X;②③④ 是否翻转:…」,并把两类方案钉死为不可推荐(让契约迁就
实现、分期半量)。二、总监席每次决裁先逐卡过一类自裁三判据,过得了的自己裁完记档,不再占用您的
批次。三、消费面与协议不一致一律对齐协议、协议没有的能力直接删,⛔ 不再立卡来问协议;但协议本身
对不对由总监席自己读协议原文加主流平台判定,判错了就直接裁协议改动。四、ADR 条目被协议取代时加
一条带日期的修订注记点名取代它的 spec 符号,不改写原文也不装没发生。五、changeset 文件按卡号命名。
六、一条裁决只算数在它自己的卡上,首行是一条固定格式的记录行;认领或派发出决策箱的卡要引这条记录。

**为什么改。** 上一批决裁里有三张卡的推荐是错的,错法一样:第一轴被当成「哪个改动最小」来打分,
于是第四轴实际拿了 75% 的权重,而您改的每一条都是从平台长远合理性出发的。规则本来就写着长远权重
≥50%,缺的是一个让违规在卡面上肉眼可见的机械步骤。另外五条来自您今天早上的三次口头校准:9306
那类卡总监席本该直接决策、以协议为准不该反过来立卡问协议、以及一条裁决到底存在在哪里。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 三个文件都卡在行数上限,所以每加一行都删了一条在别处仍然成立的旧句子
(上表逐条列出了删哪句、规则留在哪里)。真实代价是:如果哪条「留在别处」判断错了,就会静默丢一条
规则 —— 表里每一行都可以用一次 grep 复核。规则只对新记录生效,存量卡不回改。回滚成本为零:纯文本,
`git revert` 一次即可,没有任何脚本或门禁依赖这些句子。

**席位意见。**

**你要做的。** 这是受管面(`.claude/**`),按 Prime Directive #14 只能由您亲手合并 —— PR 保持
draft,⛔ 没有任何座位会把它排进合并队列。请看两处:① 上表「paid by deleting」那一列,确认每条被删
的句子确实在别处还在;② 第一条规则的措辞,尤其自检行的字面标记「只看①选」,因为后续每一批决裁都
要按字面 grep 它。
